metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Hybrid multi-Region landing zone on AWS subtitle: Security, Infrastructure and Workloads OUs in AWS Organizations; Direct Connect with VPN backup into two Regions; central inspection, logging and threat detection direction: down layout: { spacing: 0.6 } legend: solid: Network attachment or peering (both ways) thick: AWS Direct Connect, primary path dashed: AWS Site-to-Site VPN, backup path dotted: Identity, policy, DNS, logs and findings groups: dc: { type: aws:corporate-dc, label: Corporate data center } cloud: { type: aws:cloud } # The management account sits at the organization root, outside every OU; SCPs do not apply to it. mgmt: { type: aws:account, label: Management account, in: cloud } sec-ou: { type: aws:generic-dashed, icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Security OU, in: cloud } log: { type: aws:account, label: Log Archive account, in: sec-ou } tooling: { type: aws:account, label: Security Tooling account, in: sec-ou } infra-ou: { type: aws:generic-dashed, icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Infrastructure OU, in: cloud } network: { type: aws:account, label: Network account, in: infra-ou } net-east: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: network } net-west: { type: aws:region, label: us-west-2, in: network } wl-ou: { type: aws:generic-dashed, icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Workloads OU, in: cloud } nonprod: { type: aws:account, label: Non-production account, in: wl-ou } np-east: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: nonprod } np-vpc: { type: aws:vpc, label: VPC 10.9.0.0/16, in: np-east } prod: { type: aws:account, label: Production account, in: wl-ou } prod-east: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: prod } prod-vpc-east: { type: aws:vpc, label: VPC 10.1.0.0/16, in: prod-east } prod-west: { type: aws:region, label: us-west-2, in: prod } prod-vpc-west: { type: aws:vpc, label: VPC 10.2.0.0/16, in: prod-west } nodes: staff: { icon: aws:users, label: Employees, in: dc } idp: { icon: aws:saml-token, label: Corporate identity provider, note: Workforce directory, in: dc } corp-dns: { icon: aws:servers, label: Corporate DNS, in: dc } router: { icon: aws:vpc-customer-gateway, label: Customer router, note: VPN customer gateway, in: dc } dx: { icon: aws:direct-connect, label: AWS Direct Connect, note: Dedicated connection } vpn: { icon: aws:site-to-site-vpn, label: AWS Site-to-Site VPN, note: Over the internet } ct: { icon: aws:control-tower, label: AWS Control Tower, note: Landing zone, in: mgmt } org: { icon: aws:organizations, label: AWS Organizations, note: SCPs on each OU, in: mgmt } sso: { icon: aws:iam-identity-center, label: AWS IAM Identity Center, note: Permission sets in every account, in: mgmt } trail: { icon: aws:cloudtrail, label: AWS CloudTrail, note: Organization trail, in: tooling } config: { icon: aws:config, label: AWS Config, note: Organization aggregator, in: tooling } guardduty: { icon: aws:guardduty, label: Amazon GuardDuty, note: Delegated administrator, in: tooling } hub: { icon: aws:security-hub, label: AWS Security Hub, note: Delegated administrator, in: tooling } kms: { icon: aws:key-management-service, label: AWS Key Management Service, note: Log encryption key, in: tooling } bucket: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Amazon Simple Storage Service, note: "Log bucket, SSE-KMS, Object Lock", in: log } # A Direct Connect gateway is a global resource: it sits in the Network account but in no Region. dxgw: { icon: aws:direct-connect-gateway, label: Direct Connect gateway, note: Global resource, in: network } tgw-east: { icon: aws:transit-gateway, label: AWS Transit Gateway, note: Peered with us-west-2, in: net-east } nfw-east: { icon: aws:network-firewall-endpoints, label: AWS Network Firewall, note: Inspection VPC, in: net-east } dns-east: { icon: aws:route-53-resolver, label: Amazon Route 53 VPC Resolver, note: Inbound and outbound endpoints, in: net-east } tgw-west: { icon: aws:transit-gateway, label: AWS Transit Gateway, note: Peered with us-east-1, in: net-west } nfw-west: { icon: aws:network-firewall-endpoints, label: AWS Network Firewall, note: Inspection VPC, in: net-west } app-east: { icon: aws:elastic-container-service, label: Amazon ECS, note: App tier, in: prod-vpc-east } app-west: { icon: aws:elastic-container-service, label: Amazon ECS, note: App tier, in: prod-vpc-west } app-np: { icon: aws:elastic-container-service, label: Amazon Elastic Container Service, note: Staging app tier, in: np-vpc } edges: - staff ..> idp: sign in - idp ..> sso: SAML 2.0 and SCIM - router === dx: BGP - dx === dxgw: transit VIF - dxgw === tgw-east, tgw-west: association - router --- vpn: IPsec - vpn --- tgw-east: VPN attachment # The two Regions sit side by side; constraint: false keeps the peering link from stacking them. - { from: tgw-east, to: tgw-west, arrow: none, constraint: false } - tgw-east -- nfw-east: inspection - tgw-east -- dns-east - tgw-west -- nfw-west: inspection - tgw-east -- prod-vpc-east: VPC attachment - tgw-west -- prod-vpc-west: VPC attachment - tgw-east -- np-vpc: VPC attachment - corp-dns <..> dns-east: conditional forwarding - ct ..> org: applies controls - org ..> sec-ou, infra-ou, wl-ou: SCPs - org ..> tooling: delegated administrator - trail ..> bucket: all accounts - config ..> bucket: configuration snapshots - trail ..> kms: SSE-KMS - guardduty ..> hub: findings

svg.title: Hybrid multi-Region landing zone on AWS
svg.desc: Hybrid multi-Region landing zone on AWS. 24 components in 19 groups. Connections: Employees to Corporate identity provider (sign in); Corporate identity provider to AWS IAM Identity Center (SAML 2.0 and SCIM); Customer router to AWS Direct Connect (BGP); AWS Direct Connect to Direct Connect gateway (transit VIF); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway (association); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway (association); Customer router to AWS Site-to-Site VPN (IPsec); AWS Site-to-Site VPN to AWS Transit Gateway (VPN attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Transit Gateway; AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Network Firewall (inspection); AWS Transit Gateway to Amazon Route 53 VPC Resolver; AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Network Firewall (inspection); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.1.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.2.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to VPC 10.9.0.0/16 (VPC attachment); Corporate DNS to Amazon Route 53 VPC Resolver (conditional forwarding); AWS Control Tower to AWS Organizations (applies controls); AWS Organizations to Security OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Infrastructure OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Workloads OU (SCPs); AWS Organizations to Security Tooling account (delegated administrator); AWS CloudTrail to Amazon Simple Storage Service (all accounts); AWS Config to Amazon Simple Storage Service (configuration snapshots); AWS CloudTrail to AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS); and more.

text.tspan: HYBRID MULTI-REGION LANDING ZONE ON AWS
Security, Infrastructure and Workloads OUs in AWS Organizations; Direct Connect with VPN backup into two Regions; central inspection, logging and threat detection
IDENTITY, POLICY, DNS, LOGS AND FINDINGS
